purpose: Compare time-of-use charging estimates, configure charging Autopilot, apply a selected charge plan, review plan history, and inspect non-Tesla OCPP chargers.
primaryGoal: Find and explicitly apply an affordable charging window for the workspace-selected vehicle without confusing estimates, saved automation, historical savings, and observed charger data.

dataSources.name: Workspace vehicle
dataSources.behavior: Header-owned selection; resets deterministic result/applied state and remounts Autopilot by vehicle. Hook implementation not inspected.

dataSources.name: Deterministic planner and history
dataSources.behavior: Read hooks forward AbortSignal, normalize arrays, and key history by selected vehicle. Rate plans have STATIC staleTime. Apply requires live mode and invalidates/broadcasts charge-plans. Local optimizer results are estimates, not measured costs.
dataSources.contract: Inspected web\src\types\charging.ts:151-220 retains battery_capacity_kwh, kwh_needed, estimated_duration_hours and cents/kWh. This audit does not assert SI backend equivalence or authorize wire renames.

dataSources.name: Charging Autopilot
dataSources.behavior: Profile and savings are independent vehicle-scoped reads with cancellation. Save invalidates/broadcasts Autopilot; Run requires live mode and invalidates both Autopilot and charge plans. Preview does not apply a schedule. Realized savings have unknown reported time bounds.

dataSources.name: OCPP inventory and recent transactions
dataSources.behavior: Fleet-wide, not selected-Tesla history. Inventory and ten recent transactions stay independent on failure; energy_delivered_wh is passed to useUnits.formatEnergy. Reads cancel and use FAST staleTime.

dataSources.name: Opt-in Helix schedule draft
dataSources.behavior: Positive integer vehicle and nonempty rate plan gate start. Vehicle/departure scope identifies the stream. Opt-out removes the AI surface. No automatic save/apply is wired by this component.
dataSources.endpointVerification: URL observed in caller; router supplies SmartChargeSchedule handler to an integration registrar. Exact delegated route registration and stream implementation were not inspected, so mounted endpoint/runtime behavior remains unverified.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Rate-plan name/utility option mapping and fallback selection also occur in AutopilotCard.tsx:67-70, with different fallback sets. Both already share useRatePlans and its query key.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: If consolidated, put only option-label derivation in one charging-domain helper; preserve each form's explicit selected value and existing fallback policy. Do not merge query ownership or silently change defaults.

responsive.sourceStrategy: plannerColumns default=1/xl=3, factColumns default=1/sm=2/lg=4; Autopilot default=1/lg=2. Cards use min-w-0; actions and alternative/OCPP rows wrap. Chart has 24 flex bars and every-third-hour labels.

issues.detail: mobileColumns keeps only created_at, savings and status. DataTable.tsx:714-725 applies hidden md:table-cell to window, rate_plan and estimated_cost; this caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expandable details. The source-configured small-screen table lacks an in-row path to those three values.
issues.fix: Use the existing DataTable mobilePresentation full-detail contract, or retain horizontal access to all columns; preserve filtering, sorting, pagination, row IDs and tableId. Do not create a parallel mobile table.

responsive.verification: All ten mission widths, allocated-container widths, open fullscreen state, long labels, text zoom and RTL are unverified; no browser session used.

sourceStrengths: Localized field labels and explicit rate-plan/SOC/amps IDs; date/capacity use the existing input identity owner.
Action icons are aria-hidden; status has labels as well as Badge variants.
Cost comparison section has an aria-label; rate chart has named group and per-bar role=img labels including rate, tier and charge-window membership.
ChartCard receives accessible dataColumns and export/fullscreen inputs; source presence is not screen-reader acceptance.

issues.detail: Visual bar tooltip uses group-hover:block on a nonfocusable div. ARIA bar labels and ChartCard's data alternative retain information, but the visual hover affordance has no keyboard/touch equivalent in this renderer.
issues.fix: Reuse the existing accessible Tooltip policy or make the existing chart data alternative clearly discoverable on keyboard/touch; do not add a competing tooltip engine or make 24 bars unnecessary tab stops.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, focus order/restoration, screen reader, effective contrast, touch targets, forced colors and reduced motion are NOTRUN.

states.initialLoading: Plan history, Autopilot profile/savings and independent OCPP reads have skeletons; optimizer pending drives schedule/alternatives skeletons and ChartCard. Rate select uses fallbacks while the query resolves.
states.empty: Cost band persists with missing raw values; timeline, schedule, alternatives, history and both OCPP lists retain empty states; AI is intentionally absent when disabled, not a data-loss defect.
states.error: Rate plans/history/profile/savings/OCPP show QueryError with source retries; deterministic Optimize/Apply and Autopilot Save/Preview/Run surface ErrorText. ChartCard gets optimize error.
states.staleOffline: useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning preserve independent read sources. No dedicated page offline banner is shown; actual pause/offline and retained-payload rendering were not exercised.
states.successDisabled: Optimize requires vehicle and is disabled pending; Apply shows success Badge; Autopilot shows on/off, disables Run when locally off, and shows run message. Apply/Run hooks require live mode.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / failed source is not a known default
issues.detail: Fatal profile QueryError is followed by the editable default form whenever loading is false. Save at lines 158-160 is disabled only for missing vehicle/pending mutation, so a failed profile read can submit initialized defaults as a replacement profile.
issues.fix: Retain the form and retry surface but distinguish unavailable profile from a successfully returned never-saved default; prevent overwriting an unknown stored profile until recovery or an explicit supported reset workflow.

issues.detail: Vehicle change clears result/applied and success callbacks check currentVehicleId, but neither optimizeMutation nor applyMutation is reset. Their previous error/pending state can remain associated with the newly selected vehicle's form/chart. Actual switch timing was not exercised.
issues.fix: Reset or explicitly scope displayed mutation feedback when vehicle identity changes while retaining command-side effects, live-mode safeguards and history invalidation; test pending, failure and rapid selection changes.

visualIssues.detail: Positive savings body text is fixed text-emerald-300 instead of a theme-resolved semantic foreground. This is toned-down rather than neon, but is still a light-theme/contrast risk; contrast is not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing semantic success foreground or typography token without changing positive/missing savings semantics.

visualIssues.detail: Tier swatches/bars hardcode emerald/amber/red 500 at 40-50% opacity and charge-window bars use primary at 60% with an accent ring (lines 109-111). These are source-level saturated treatments to review, not proved excessive rendered noise. No neon/glow/pure-white matches were found in the page.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing restrained chart/semantic palette contracts while keeping every tier, relative rate height, window membership, legend and data alternative; preserve saved theme/chart choices.

visualIssues.detail: Shared Helix action overrides Button border/background/text/focus with fixed cyan-400/500 and dark:text-cyan-100. The badge also hardcodes cyan at line 214. This is an accent-saturation/theme-noise candidate, not measured visual failure or literal pure-white/neon.
visualIssues.fix: Review one existing AIFeatureCard action/badge theme treatment with semantic tokens, retaining brand identity, streaming/disabled states, localized names and motion preference. No page-local restyle.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports LayoutCard/ChartCard from layout/layout-reference and StatMetric from data-display/stat-reference (line 7); ChargePointsCard.tsx:3 does the same for LayoutCard. layout/index.ts:8,11-12 already exports the identical canonical owners.
architectureIssues.fix: Use @/components/layout and @/components/data-display category exports; do not copy or replace the reference implementations.

architectureIssues.detail: formatHour emits hardcoded 12a/12p and English a/p suffixes instead of the existing user's time-format preference. fmtNumber localizes rates, but these hour labels bypass useDateFormat.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing localized time display owner with explicit tariff wall-clock-hour semantics; retain midnight/cross-midnight interpretation and do not invent a tariff timezone.

architectureIssues.detail: chargeWindow drops minutes/date/offset into local getHours and endHour||24 before highlighting. AutopilotCard.tsx:214-215 repeats it. Non-hour-aligned windows can be visually rounded down; tariff-hour timezone equivalence is not established by inspected types.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain exact timestamps in the schedule facts/export; agree a single domain window-to-hour overlap rule using known hourly-rate timezone semantics and cover fractional-hour, midnight and DST cases before changing the highlight.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045 / do not invent observed data
architectureIssues.detail: SmartChargePage.tsx:390-397 supplies no currentSoc, so draft payload uses current_soc=20. Invalid/blank departure silently becomes now at lines 74-77. Manual planner instead rejects invalid departure. Whether backend uses or replaces the SOC hint is unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the draft capability but explicitly label assumptions or supply an existing authoritative SOC source; align validation with the manual form without fabricating measured SOC or inventing backend behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: Default brief description says Recorded measurements although page cost metrics and Autopilot preview explicitly use unknown periods explained as optimizer estimates. Source-specific reasons are preserved in provenance/narrative, but the generic description can contradict them.
architectureIssues.fix: Supply an estimate-specific description from each estimate caller, retaining historical realized-savings description and unknown time bounds. Reuse the existing description prop rather than changing all charging summaries globally.

architectureIssues.detail: Current planner/AI/Autopilot contracts are kWh/hour/cents-per-kWh shaped. The page bridges batteryCapacity kWh to UnitInput Wh at lines 487-490 and energy metric kWh to Wh at line 298; inspected convertEnergyFromSI confirms this arithmetic. This is a bounded existing-contract exception, not permission for new legacy fields.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current payload semantics during presentation work. Any canonical wire migration needs coordinated types/hooks/backend evidence and the Phase-48 methodology; never simply rename units or remove the existing boundary conversions.

priority.reason: Profile-read failure can leave default Save enabled; mobile history omits critical plan details; estimate/source assumptions and scope feedback need explicit treatment. Existing modernized composition should be preserved, not redesigned from scratch.
order: Category imports and restrained theme styling

requiredSharedChanges.name: AIFeatureCard semantic action/badge treatment

variants: Existing Button outline and Badge/brand treatment; no new variant required

requiredSharedChanges.reason: One shared style owner, not a page override. This scoped audit confirms only this consumer; other production consumers require inventory reconciliation before a shared contract extension.

competingImplementations.detail: Manual optimization, saved Autopilot and opt-in AI all schedule-related, but have different source ownership and actions. Shared RateTimeline and ChargingSummaryBrief already remove presentation duplication; these are not interchangeable business workflows.
competingImplementations.fix: Retain all three workflows; only deduplicate presentation/option mapping through the existing charging owners.

preservation.sectionCountingConvention: Nine individually named top-level surfaces; nested Autopilot preview/savings and OCPP inventory/transactions are explicitly retained separately.
actions: Header-owned vehicle selection (consume, do not duplicate)
Select rate plan; adjust target SOC 20-100 step 5; edit local departure, max amps 8-80 and battery capacity
Find cheapest window after validation; show errors and pending state
Apply optimized plan with live-mode safeguard; show applied success and apply failure
Timeline accessible data view, export and fullscreen through ChartCard
History sort, value filters, pagination and existing persisted table controls
Retry rate plans/history, profile/savings and independent OCPP reads
Autopilot enable, daily ready-by, current SOC, target SOC, daily cap, rate plan, max amps, trip override and preconditioning
Save Autopilot, preview next run and live-mode Run now with feedback
Opt-in Ask Helix draft, streaming output and error states
dataBehavior: Tomorrow 07:30 departure built from local calendar fields, then validated and serialized to ISO for requests.
Default SOC 80, amps 32, capacity 75 kWh and backend-first rate options with existing named fallback IDs remain.
UnitInput takes Wh; page retains the existing kWh-shaped optimizer boundary bridge. Numeric zero remains distinct from unavailable metrics.
Unknown costs/energy/SOC render missing markers; estimates never become observed historical charging measurements.
Every hourly rate and alternative window retains time, rate/tier/cost; no sampling or fabricated tariff values.
History retains created time, scheduled window, rate plan, cost, savings and lifecycle status; tableId charging:smart-charge-history and record id key remain.
Autopilot retains stored profile hydration, independent savings, estimated preview, capped-target explanation and command results.
OCPP stays fleet-wide and separate from Tesla vehicle scope; preserve vendor/model/id, last-seen, all connectors/statuses, active count and ten recent transaction identifiers/energy.
Retain AI-off gate, scope identity, positive-integer vehicle validation and no automatic draft application.
Preserve query keys, cancellation, stale times, invalidation/broadcast and request live-mode guards; do not add a duplicate workspace range/vehicle selector.
Planner departure and daily ready-by are business dates, not a historical workspace date range; no new range picker is warranted.
